movies.overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.
movies.tagline: Defy the gods.
movies.title: The Odyssey

movies.overview: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.
movies.tagline: Our truth. Our history
movies.title: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend

movies.overview: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.
movies.tagline: Before he was Scrooge, he was…
movies.title: Ebenezer

movies.overview: Inside the colorful world of "It's Buddy!", a group of children spend their days singing, dancing, and helping Buddy - bright orange unicorn - spread happiness. But when one child refuses to play along, Buddy is not pleased and cracks begin to appear in this seemingly perfect world.
movies.tagline: It's Buddy!
movies.title: Buddy

movies.overview: An elite military unit on a mission in the South American jungle encounters a deadly supernatural force revealing an ancient presence that continues to claim anyone who dares enter its domain.
movies.tagline: Old sins. New blood.
movies.title: The Awakening

movies.overview: Influenced by a sinister Cricket and created by Geppetto, Pinocchio launches a violent crusade to carve himself into a real boy like his brother James, one piece at a time.
movies.tagline: He has no strings to hold him back now.
movies.title: Pinocchio: Unstrung

movies.overview: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue's abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.
movies.tagline: How far would you go for those you love?
movies.title: Wildwood

movies.overview: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!
movies.tagline: Ready. Set. Fight.
movies.title: Street Fighter

movies.overview: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa must race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.
movies.tagline: No memory left behind.
movies.title: Forgotten Island

movies.overview: Assigned his toughest mission yet, the Cat must cheer up siblings Gabby and Sebastian as they adjust to life in a new town. Known for pushing boundaries, this agent of chaos must prove himself or risk losing his magical hat forever.
movies.tagline: The cat's out of the bag.
movies.title: The Cat in the Hat

movies.overview: A queen sacrifices herself to protect her son, the prince, from invading enemies.Mookuthi Amman returns to protect the child and confronts a mysterious woman who embodies a new and dangerous evil.

movies.overview: Teenage Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.
movies.tagline: The ocean chose her for a reason.
movies.title: Moana

movies.overview: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.
movies.tagline: Marriage material.
movies.title: Wicker

movies.tagline: The world will not exonerate her.
movies.title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising-

movies.overview: Tired of scaring humans every October 31 with the same old bag of tricks, Jack Skellington, the spindly Pumpkin King of Halloween Town, kidnaps Santa Claus and plans to deliver shrunken heads and other ghoulish gifts to children on Christmas morning in his place. But, as the holiday approaches, Jack's rag-doll girlfriend Sally tries to foil his well-meaning yet misguided plans.
movies.tagline: A holiday film for the whole family... except yours.
movies.title: The Nightmare Before Christmas

movies.overview: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands and threatens to upend the peace they sacrificed everything to achieve.
movies.tagline: The legacy reawakens.
movies.title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender

movies.overview: The Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.
movies.tagline: Everything you've witched for.

movies.overview: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.
movies.tagline: Hollywood has a monster problem.
movies.title: Minions & Monsters

movies.overview: After releasing the Chupacabras, Leo San Juan decides that it is time to return together with his brother Nando to his grandmother's house. Halfway down the road, Charro Negro manages to confuse Leo and because of him, an innocent girl is dragged into the underworld. Leo is forced to repair the damage. His friends will come to try to help him and get out of there as soon as possible. But it is no coincidence that the Charro has chosen to involve Leo, his intentions go beyond getting a new soul.
movies.title: The Legend of the Black Charro

movies.overview: Wandering her rambling old house in her boring new town, 11-year-old Coraline discovers a hidden door to a strangely idealized version of her life. In order to stay in the fantasy, she must make a frighteningly real sacrifice.
movies.tagline: Be careful what you wish for.
movies.title: Coraline

movies.overview: In the wake of the devastating war against the RDA and the loss of their eldest son, Jake Sully and Neytiri face a new threat on Pandora: the Ash People, a violent and power-hungry Na'vi tribe led by the ruthless Varang. Jake's family must fight for their survival and the future of Pandora in a conflict that pushes them to their emotional and physical limits.
movies.tagline: The world of Pandora will change forever.
movies.title: Avatar: Fire and Ash

movies.original_title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
movies.overview: Harry Potter has lived under the stairs at his aunt and uncle's house his whole life. But on his 11th birthday, he learns he's a powerful wizard—with a place waiting for him at the Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. As he learns to harness his newfound powers with the help of the school's kindly headmaster, Harry uncovers the truth about his parents' deaths—and about the villain who's to blame.
movies.tagline: Let the magic begin.
movies.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone

belongs_to_collection.name: The Lord of the Rings Collection

movies.overview: Young hobbit Frodo Baggins, after inheriting a mysterious ring from his uncle Bilbo, must leave his home in order to keep it from falling into the hands of its evil creator. Along the way, a fellowship is formed to protect the ringbearer and make sure that the ring arrives at its final destination: Mt. Doom, the only place where it can be destroyed.
movies.tagline: One ring to rule them all.
movies.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring

belongs_to_collection.name: The Lord of the Rings Collection

movies.original_title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
movies.overview: As armies mass for a final battle that will decide the fate of the world--and powerful, ancient forces of Light and Dark compete to determine the outcome--one member of the Fellowship of the Ring is revealed as the noble heir to the throne of the Kings of Men. Yet, the sole hope for triumph over evil lies with a brave hobbit, Frodo, who, accompanied by his loyal friend Sam and the hideous, wretched Gollum, ventures deep into the very dark heart of Mordor on his seemingly impossible quest to destroy the Ring of Power.​
movies.tagline: There can be no triumph without loss. No victory without suffering. No freedom without sacrifice.
movies.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King

movies.overview: A young girl, Chihiro, becomes trapped in a strange new world of spirits. When her parents undergo a mysterious transformation, she must call upon the courage she never knew she had to free her family.
movies.tagline: Prepare to be spirited away.
movies.title: Spirited Away

movies.overview: The Demon Slayer Corps are drawn into the Infinity Castle, where Tanjiro, Nezuko, and the Hashira face terrifying Upper Rank demons in a desperate fight as the final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji begins.
movies.tagline: It's time to have some fun.
movies.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle

movies.overview: In a 19th-century European village, a young man about to be married is whisked away to the underworld and wed to a mysterious corpse bride, while his real bride waits bereft in the land of the living.
movies.tagline: There's been a grave misunderstanding.
movies.title: Corpse Bride

movies.overview: Having thwarted Bowser's previous plot to marry Princess Peach, Mario and Luigi now face a fresh threat in Bowser Jr., who is determined to liberate his father from captivity and restore the family legacy. Alongside companions new and old, the brothers travel across the stars to stop the young heir's crusade.
movies.tagline: The galaxy awaits.
movies.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie

movies.original_title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
movies.overview: Frodo Baggins and the other members of the Fellowship continue on their sacred quest to destroy the One Ring--but on separate paths. Their destinies lie at two towers - Orthanc Tower in Isengard, where the corrupt wizard Saruman awaits, and Sauron's fortress at Barad-dur, deep within the dark lands of Mordor.
movies.tagline: The journey continues.
movies.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers

movies.original_title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
movies.overview: Cars fly, trees fight back, and a mysterious house-elf comes to warn Harry Potter at the start of his second year at Hogwarts. Adventure and danger await when bloody writing on a wall announces: The Chamber Of Secrets Has Been Opened. To save Hogwarts will require all of Harry, Ron and Hermione's magical abilities and courage.
movies.tagline: Something evil has returned to Hogwarts!
movies.title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets

movies.overview: Exactly one year after young rock guitarist Eric Draven and his fiancée are brutally killed by a ruthless gang of criminals, Draven, watched over by a hypnotic crow, returns from the grave to exact revenge.
movies.tagline: Believe in angels.
movies.title: The Crow

movies.overview: Sophie, a young milliner, is turned into an elderly woman by a witch who enters her shop and curses her. She encounters a wizard named Howl and gets caught up in his resistance to fighting for the king.
movies.tagline: A magician, a witch, a castle that has life. A fantastic journey into the world of imagination.
movies.title: Howl's Moving Castle

movies.overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.
movies.tagline: An adventure of prehistoric pawportions.
movies.title: PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie

movies.overview: A small woodland creature and a majestic bird, two natural sworn enemies of the Valley, magically trade places and set off on an adventure of a lifetime to switch back. Their journey soon uncovers a greater threat—one that could endanger not only their species, but the entire valley they call home.
movies.tagline: Transform your destiny.
movies.title: Swapped

movies.original_title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
movies.overview: After his name emerges from the Goblet of Fire, Harry Potter becomes a competitor in a grueling battle for glory among three wizarding schools in the Triwizard Tournament. But if Harry never submitted his name for the Tournament, then who did? Nevertheless, Harry must confront a deadly dragon, fierce water monsters, and an enchanted maze—only to find himself in the cruel grasp of He Who Must Not Be Named.
movies.tagline: Dark and difficult times lie ahead.
movies.title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

movies.original_title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
movies.overview: Doctor Strange, with the help of mystical allies both old and new, traverses the mind-bending and dangerous alternate realities of the Multiverse to confront a mysterious new adversary.
movies.tagline: Enter a new dimension of Strange.
movies.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

movies.original_title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
movies.overview: Year three at Hogwarts means new fun and new challenges as Harry learns the delicate art of approaching a Hippogriff, transforming shape-shifting Boggarts into hilarity and even turning back time. But the term also brings danger: soul-sucking Dementors hover over the school, an ally of the accursed He-Who-Cannot-Be-Named lurks within the castle walls, and fearsome wizard Sirius Black escapes Azkaban. And Harry will confront them all.
movies.tagline: Something wicked this way comes.
movies.title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban

movies.original_title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
movies.overview: When wily pirate Captain Barbossa seizes Jack Sparrow’s beloved ship, the Black Pearl, and kidnaps the governor’s daughter, Elizabeth Swann, blacksmith Will Turner reluctantly teams up with the unpredictable pirate Jack to rescue her—only to uncover a terrifying curse that turns Barbossa’s crew into the undead.
movies.tagline: Prepare to be blown out of the water.
movies.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl

movies.overview: When K-pop superstars Rumi, Mira and Zoey aren't selling out stadiums, they're using their secret powers to protect their fans from supernatural threats.
movies.tagline: They sing. They dance. They battle demons.
movies.title: KPop Demon Hunters

movies.overview: A supernatural tale set on death row in a Southern prison, where gentle giant John Coffey possesses the mysterious power to heal people's ailments. When the cell block's head guard, Paul Edgecomb, recognizes Coffey's miraculous gift, he tries desperately to help stave off the condemned man's execution.
movies.tagline: Paul Edgecomb didn't believe in miracles. Until the day he met one.
movies.title: The Green Mile

movies.overview: Its events revolve around the return of the mammoth, a giant extinct creature, to life as a result of scientific experiments through genetic modifications, and for some reason the creature exists and grows in the heart of Cairo.
movies.tagline: A Giant Returns. A Story Begins
movies.title: Oscar: Return of the Mammoth

movies.overview: It ain't easy bein' green -- especially if you're a likable (albeit smelly) ogre named Shrek. On a mission to retrieve a gorgeous princess from the clutches of a fire-breathing dragon, Shrek teams up with an unlikely compatriot -- a wisecracking donkey.
movies.tagline: The greatest fairy tale never told.
movies.title: Shrek

movies.overview: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.
movies.tagline: Legends never die.
movies.title: Legend of the White Dragon

movies.original_title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
movies.overview: Harry, Ron and Hermione continue their quest to vanquish the evil Voldemort once and for all. Just as things begin to look hopeless for the young wizards, Harry discovers a trio of magical objects that endow him with powers to rival Voldemort's formidable skills.
movies.tagline: It all ends.
movies.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2

movies.overview: In one of Paris's finest restaurants, Remy, a determined young rat, dreams of becoming a renowned French chef. Torn between his family's wishes and his true calling, Remy and his pal Linguini set in motion a hilarious chain of events that turns the City of Lights upside down.
movies.tagline: He's dying to become a chef.
movies.title: Ratatouille

movies.overview: When Bella Swan moves to a small town in the Pacific Northwest, she falls in love with Edward Cullen, a mysterious classmate who reveals himself to be a 108-year-old vampire. Despite Edward's repeated cautions, Bella can't stay away from him, a fatal move that endangers her own life.
movies.tagline: When you can live forever, what do you live for?
movies.title: Twilight

movies.original_title: 劇場版 チェンソーマン レゼ篇
movies.overview: In a world where devils are born from humanity’s fears, Denji has only ever dreamed of living a simple life, eating good food, finding happiness, and experiencing the warmth of being loved. Then, one rainy afternoon, fate leads him to Reze, a mysterious girl working at a small café. With her disarming smile, playful charm, and unexpected kindness, she offers Denji something he has rarely known—a glimpse of an ordinary life beyond bloodshed and chaos.
movies.tagline: A heart caught between the warmth of love and the blast of destruction.
movies.title: Chainsaw Man - The Movie: Reze Arc

movies.overview: After being separated for 15 years, the Sword of Power leads Prince Adam back to Eternia, where he discovers his home shattered under the fiendish rule of Skeletor. To save his family and his world, Adam must join forces with his closest allies, Teela and Duncan/Man-At-Arms, and embrace his true destiny as He-Man — the most powerful man in the universe.
movies.tagline: Legends aren't born, they're forged.
movies.title: Masters of the Universe

movies.overview: Barbie “Brooklyn” Roberts steps into the role of the Sugarplum Princess and Barbie “Malibu” Roberts stars as Clara, as they journey through a musical, magical dreamworld filled with holiday wonder, courage and friendship.
movies.title: Barbie in the Nutcracker

movies.original_title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1
movies.overview: Harry, Ron and Hermione walk away from their last year at Hogwarts to find and destroy the remaining Horcruxes, putting an end to Voldemort's bid for immortality. But with Harry's beloved Dumbledore dead and Voldemort's unscrupulous Death Eaters on the loose, the world is more dangerous than ever.
movies.tagline: Nowhere is safe.
movies.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1
